title: Mixed Extension Of A Matrix Game
body_html:
Mixed Extension Of A Matrix Game

For a finite matrix game $A : I \times J \to \mathbb{R}$, the mixed extension has strategy spaces $\Delta(I)$ and $\Delta(J)$. Its payoff is the bilinear extension $$ g(x,y)=\sum_{i \in I}\sum_{j \in J} x_i y_j A_{ij}. $$ Pure strategies are identified with Dirac measures in the corresponding simplex.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 2, Section 2.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Mixed extension and multilinear payoff.
